title: rel0-4-4: Sidecar 0.4.4 mods, OS 1.73
description: The mods for Sidecar 0.4.4 on OS 1.73, for a Rytm you keep on 1.73 (Elektron offers only 1.74 now): everything in rel0-4-0, plus a held step's values on the Sidecar's SRC view (while you hold a step in GRID RECORDING, the view shows its locks and follows your knob turns on them), and the CONNECTED screen also when the Rytm boots with the Sidecar already attached. The same file elekloader builds from core 0.1 + rytm-sidecar-0.4.4.elemod with version 1.73 (sha256 421cccc9...acf26). Goes with Sidecar 0.4.4 on the Pi.
